document.abstract: In order to correlate photographs with other recorded data, the optical system of a galvanometer oscillograph was modified so that it could record on the film in the exposure aperture of a 16-mm Fastax camera. The addition of the galvanometer system required no permanent alterations of the Fastax camera and provided a record in the form of a spot which moved horizontally in the field of view when the film was projected.
